name: WhileLoop
caption: While Loop

edges.rules: Exactly one edge with value "loop". Its steps are the loop body. After every pass of the body, the While step is dispatched again and re-evaluates the condition. When the condition is false, the step emits an empty result, and the flow continues after the loop.

configuration.description: SmartFilter expression, same grammar as the Decision step's condition. It is re-substituted and re-evaluated on every pass, so it should reference values that the body changes. An empty or unparseable condition evaluates to false.

0 = While (check the condition before every pass, including the first), 1 = Do-While (run the body once without checking, then check before every further pass). A missing or unknown value is treated as 0.
Runaway guard: the maximum number of body passes. The runtime uses 1000 when the value is missing or <= 0, but the editor requires >= 1.

rules.check: configuration.maxIterations must be an integer >= 1 (a missing key reads as 0 and fails)
configuration.mode should be 0 or 1 (anything else is treated as 0 = While)
If the condition is still true on dispatch number maxIterations+1 (i.e. after maxIterations body passes), the step fails
rules.message: The While loop did not terminate within its configured maximum of %1 iterations. Review the condition or raise the limit on the step.

notes: The 'iteration' output is the 1-based dispatch number of the While step. Inside the body, pass N has iteration = N.

Limit semantics: the body can run at most maxIterations times. If the condition becomes false on the dispatch right after the last allowed pass, the loop ends cleanly. Only a condition that is still true then raises the error.
Do-While: on the first dispatch the condition is not evaluated, so the body always runs at least once. With mode 0, a condition that is false at the start skips the body entirely.
The step emits a runtime-only 'result' ('loop' to enter the body, '' to exit) that the engine routes on. It is not declared in outputs[].

Outputs of steps INSIDE the body are deleted every time control returns to the While step, so a condition cannot read body-step outputs. Make the condition depend on data that persists, such as records the body modifies or variables/collections outside the loop.
The editor's configuration check returns pass/fail without message text. Nothing checks the condition or the limit at publish time.
